audit_items.proof_trace: Ctokens are removed from the obligation in-place at L328 before `is_obligation_safe` is called at L332, ensuring the safety check operates on the post-withdrawal state. The safety check computes weighted risk (`collateral * collateral_factor >= debt * borrow_weight`) using EMA-bounded prices; since collateral_factor < 1.0 and borrow_weight >= 1.0 (typical values 0.7-0.9 and 1.1-1.2), this is strictly more conservative than the raw debt/collateral ratio, so passing the weighted check guarantees raw debt/collateral < 1.0. The boundary-equality case (`collateral_weighted == debt_weighted`, comment L1247) is intentional design and, given typical weight parameters, still corresponds to raw debt/collateral well below 1.0.
